senses.gloss: f. (דּוּק) stalks of flax beaten once (still hard and knotty), contrad. to דַּקְדַּקְתָּא thoroughly beaten, tow.
units: Ḥull. 51ᵇ ד׳ חיישינן וכ׳ if a bird falls upon dakta, we must apprehend internal injury, if on daktakta, we need not.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 26a:2">B. Bath. 26ᵃ</cite> top <he>הוה אזלא ד׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. oth. (ed. <cite ref="T00001"><he>ר׳</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) pieces of stalks flew off and injured people.
